title: Will a heat pump save you money? It depends
summary: A 2024 Canary Media column on the NREL/LBNL national study: heat pump savings depend on the fuel replaced, AC, incentives, rates and weatherization.

assertions.quote: a like-for-like furnace or boiler replacement (i.e. swapping a broken gas system for a new gas one) costs on average just $5,000
that combo would cost on average $11,000, which is still much less than the average sticker price of upgrading to a medium-efficiency heat pump
heat pumps make economic sense for an estimated 65 million out of 110 million households in the U.S.
The 2022 Inflation Reduction Act includes a $2,000 federal tax credit for heat pumps
Massachusetts issues rebates as massive as $16,000 for income-qualified households.
some utility customers in Maine can already get lower electric rates for using heat pumps
“If you’re converting from fuel oil, propane or electric resistance, those tend to be pretty expensive heating fuels, so you could save quite a bit
for more than half of homes that use natural gas for heating, there was a financial benefit from switching to a heat pump
a sure way consumers can save on their bills is if they can rid themselves of their gas connection entirely
It can even lower the upfront costs of a heat-pump system by up to $3,700, because a better-insulated home requires less heating power.
Heat pumps are undisputed winners for the climate.
